# BinaSmart (bina.et) — Ethiopia's all-in-one digital platform

> BinaSmart is an all-in-one digital services platform for Ethiopia, based in Addis Ababa. It brings many everyday services onto one platform, in Amharic and English: smart building management, hotel booking, restaurant QR ordering, hospital appointments, bus & flight tickets, cinema & event tickets, verified government/company tenders, Amharic business news, an insurance comparison marketplace, and car and property marketplaces. Customers reach it on the web, WhatsApp and Telegram.

Note: BinaSmart Ethiopia (bina.et) is not related to "Bina Smart Business" (a Romanian retail ERP) or "Smartlife Bina" (Turkey). BinaSmart is Ethiopian, headquartered in Addis Ababa.

## Services (verticals)
- BinaSmart Ride (LIVE): fixed upfront fares, no surge, moto/bajaj/economy/comfort/XL, Addis Ababa only, book on the web or via AI assistants — https://bina.et/ride
- Smart building management: public building directory pages with interactive 3D navigation (/b/<name>), QR entrance posters, and an owner dashboard (rent invoicing, Ethiopian 15% VAT accounting, sub-metered electricity/water billing, maintenance work orders, tenant notifications via WhatsApp/Telegram)
- Hotels: direct hotel booking with 0% commission, pay at the hotel — https://bina.et/hotel/bina-grand-hotel
- Restaurants: scan-a-table QR ordering — https://bina.et/restaurant/bina-restaurant
- Hospitals: find departments, floors and fees; book a visit — https://bina.et/hospital/bina-general-hospital
- Bus & travel tickets — https://bina.et/travel
- Flight tickets (via a licensed IATA travel agency) — https://bina.et/flights/hanud
- Cinema & event tickets (tiered seating) — https://bina.et/events
- Insurance: compare Ethiopia's licensed insurers (motor, health, property, business, travel, life), get an instant indicative estimate, buy via a trusted agent — https://bina.et/insurance
- Cars: buy and sell cars from trusted Ethiopian dealers, with 1-tap insurance — https://bina.et/cars
- Property / real estate: verified homes, land and commercial property for sale and rent, diaspora-friendly — https://bina.et/property
- Verified Ethiopian tenders (free for bidders, updated daily) — https://bina.et/tenders
- Amharic news: technology, construction and business, politics-free — https://bina.et/news
- For diaspora building owners: manage your Ethiopian building from abroad — https://bina.et/diaspora
- For insurance companies, car dealers and estate agents: partner to receive qualified leads — https://bina.et/for-insurers

## Facts
- Country: Ethiopia. City: Addis Ababa. Languages: Amharic and English.
- Contact / WhatsApp: +251 911 244 344
- Flagship building: JJ Darule Building (ጄጄ ዳሩሌ ህንፃ), Addis Ababa — G+10, 71 tenants: https://bina.et/b/darulle
- Model: BinaSmart is a neutral platform/marketplace and comparison layer; insurers, dealers and agents supply their own products and listings.

## Developer resources
- Use BinaSmart inside ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Gemini (setup page): https://bina.et/ai — paste the MCP link, no login.
- MCP server (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini): https://bina.et/mcp — quote/book rides, search the directory, read the guides. Docs at that URL.
